seed_data.title: Facial Moisturiser SPF 50+
seed_data.description:
The urban shield that protects, hydrates, and disappears. Ultra-lightweight with zero grease, zero white cast - just smooth, matte finish.

Broad-spectrum SPF 50+ blocks UVA/UVB rays 

Anti-pollutant tech defends against dust and free radicals 

Hyaluronic acid + niacinamide hydrate and strengthen 

Instantly absorbs - no residue, no shine 

Matte finish that feels like second skin 

Apply AM as final step for all-day protection

seed_data.title: Daily Cleanser
seed_data.description:
A gel-to-foam cleanser that removes daily grime without stripping your skin's natural barrier. Fresh, soft, and never tight. 

Deeply lifts oil, sweat, and pollutants 

Maintains essential moisture 

Balances skin pH 

Non-drying, gentle formula 

Preps skin for serums and moisturizers 

Use morning and night

seed_data.title: Exfoliating Facial Scrub
seed_data.description:
Smooth. Bright. Refined. Skin-friendly particles remove dead cells and boost turnover for next-level clarity. 

Gently lifts dulling dead skin cells 

Stimulates natural cell turnover 

Refines texture and targets roughness 

Uncovers smoother, brighter skin 

Skin-friendly particles - never harsh 

One essential step for visible results
